architecture: compile-time vocabulary validation plus subject-scoped immutable snapshot lexicon

compile_time.runtime_term_cardinality: zero, one, or multiple subjective referents
compile_time.knowledge_creation: declaration does not establish recognition; aliases require subject-visible cognitive input

snapshot.lexicon: Chinese term -> immutable candidate ReferentId set
snapshot.capture_consistency: one cognition commit boundary; host serialization or approved Core capture required
snapshot.evaluation_mutation: forbidden; ongoing observation commits affect only later snapshots
snapshot.absence_belief: may remain lexically referable; action applicability is a separate predicate

resolution.ui_boolean_bridge: explicit Resolved plus Truth.True; never generic object truthiness for Core Truth enum or result objects
resolution.two_viable_candidates: Ambiguous; return both IDs and subject-visible descriptions
resolution.qualifier_unknown: retain uncertainty; cannot exclude as false to manufacture uniqueness

execution.bridge: validated live subjective Projection -> existing Core effect; frozen snapshot references never submitted
execution.objective_feasibility: formal Core activation phase; cannot be used to correct prior subjective query

history_and_persistence.current_observation_history: not sufficient for full immutable rebuild
history_and_persistence.initial_candidate_behavior: explicit Unsupported for rebuild/restore until separately approved
conditional_future_requirement: world ownership and AST reference restore
